items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I took lessons from Willie, uncle's grandfather.

ctx.x: Classical, right. Do you remember what she played? Any pieces? No.

The reason why I don't know, because when I was born, she had gave that up. Oh, I see. Because she gave me that violin when I got around about 10 years old. She gave it to me. Did you play anything? I took lessons from Willie, uncle's grandfather. I was going to school and taking lessons from him. Then I didn't like instruments, so I gave it up, too.
